operations.name: findDeliveryStore
operations.description: Which store delivers to an address. Returns Domino's normalised address and storeNo (use with getMenu).

operations.name: getMenu
operations.description: A store's menu for serviceMethod Pickup or Delivery (prices differ). type=Product rows are items (sizes + prices); type=Voucher rows are the store's deals (code = voucher code). storeNo comes from findStores or findDeliveryStore.
